Dry Glaze Dust, Wear Mask. This CAUTION Glaze Mixing Station sign from CGAP Safety reads: DRY GLAZE IS DUSTY / WEAR DUST MASK AND GLOVES / MIX AT BENCH ONLY. Written for high school art rooms, university ceramics studios, community art centers and pottery schools.

Why this sign matters

Reduces dust and skin irritation when weighing and mixing dry glaze materials.

Where to post it

Mount on the wall above the glaze mixing bench.

Who orders it

School art teachers, ceramics studio managers, university art department facilities staff.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: ANSI Z535.4 CAUTION; kiln manufacturer instructions; site practice. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
